findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auth_request_otp · Private data: compile_workflow, detect_workflows, auth_request_otp, auth_verify_otp, auth_login · Public sink: auth_request_otp, auth_verify_otp · Destructive: auth_request_otp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auth_request_otp · Private data: compile_workflow, detect_workflows, auth_request_otp, auth_verify_otp, auth_login · Public sink: auth_request_otp, auth_verify_otp · Destructive: auth_request_otp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
